title: Rising Spire
description:
What to ExpectRising Spire is a story-driven, turn-based RPG built around exploration, character relationships, and party-based combat.

• Turn-Based Party Combat- Fight alongside a growing cast of party members, each with their own abilities, strengths, and role in battle.

• Atlas's Weapon-Based Combat- Equip different weapons as Atlas to change his play-style and adapt his role in battle.

• A Character-Driven Story - Follow Atlas, a young Nephilim caught between Gods and Angels, as he searches for his place in a much larger conflict.

• Explore a Pixel-Art World- Travel through towns, caverns, mountains, and story locations filled with characters, quests, encounters, and things to discover.

• Character Arcs & Side Stories- Spend time with the people you meet, help with their problems, and uncover stories beyond the main quest.

• Party Progression - Grow stronger through equipment, abilities, stats, and new ways to build each member of your party.

• Bosses & Unique Encounters- Face story battles, minibosses, and larger encounters designed to test how you use your party.

 
Rising Spire is a turn-based RPG born from our love for timeless names such as early Final Fantasy, Legend of Zelda, and Persona. Play as a Nephilim embarking on an epic journey through the harsh world of Malus - a world caught between the divine war between Angels and Gods. Find the balance between humanity and divinity, form unexpected alliances, and pray that you are doing the right thing. The road to Hell is paved with good intentions.

Rising Spire ditches the traditional class system in favor of a weapons switch system. As you progress through the game, you unlock new weapons, each with its unique abilities, runes and style of gameplay. Tweak your build and lead your party to victory, whether you focus on damage, tank, or support abilities.

Every denizen of Malus has a rich and full existence - while you can take the quick path and rush to the Spire, the full depth of Atlas' journey can only be uncovered by interacting with the characters you meet along the way, hearing their stories, and maybe even helping them out. Complete all Character Arcs for the full experience!

"Those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it". As it turns out, this is applicable not just for humans, but divine beings as well. The last war between Gods and Angels had devastating effects for everything caught in its blast. But that was a long time ago. In times of peace, a small mistake doesn't mean as much, does it? 

Except it does. The exiled Angels, now known as Daemons, have made several small mistakes in their attempt to flee the wrath of the Gods. As the consequences of these mistakes come slowly creeping in, the fate of Malus is put in the feeble hands of a young Nephilim. Inexperienced and potentially blind-sided, will you be able to tell right from wrong?
description_short: Rising Spire is a turn based RPG inspired by the classics. Play as Atlas, a young Nephilim whose world is on the brink of destruction at the hand of Divinity itself. Explore, forge deep relationships and hone your powers in this immersive coming-of-age story.
